title: Finland – Scanning probe microscopes – Flow imaging microscope
description: The object of the procurement is a flow imaging microscopy system for morphological analysis and numerical estimation of particles in water (size distribution 2µm – 1 mm) under laboratory conditions. The device must be able to image plankton and other particles in water as color images, calculate indicators related to cell and particle size, pigmentation, color and shape from the images, and enable the easy processing of large sample volumes in a reasonable time. The device must be able to separate phytoplankton cells from other particles using chlorophyll fluorescence and enable the use of fluorescent dyes (FITC). The analytics performed by the device must be able to be monitored in real time to ensure quality control. The device software must support basic analytics and classification of particle data. The device must also be able to be used reliably in field conditions on a research vessel.

title: RFI - Seasonal Great Lakes Ice-Breaking
description: DESCRIPTION The United States Coast Guard (USCG) is conducting market research to identify sources capable of providing vessels, including all labor, vessel equipment and supervision, to conduct domestic ice breaking in support of USCG District Great Lakes (D-GL). Domestic ice-breaking capabilities include navigable waterways and commercial channels impacted by seasonal ice from January 2, 2027 through April 1, 2027. The vessel must hold a valid U.S. Coast Guard Certificate of Inspection with the proper routes and conditions to operate in the Great lakes and must be in compliance with applicable U.S. laws and regulations, including manning and Classification Society requirements (if applicable). For ice-breaking planning purposes, the intended capability for a vessel includes the ability to break 1st year freshwater ice plates of 12� or greater and can ideally break freshwater ice plates up to 36�. The contractor shall provide all labor, transportation (including locking fees), equipment, and supervision necessary to be in the Great Lakes by January 2, 2027, and be available as follows for daily operations: Vessel shall be available for ice breaking operations up to twelve (12) hours per day during daylight hours. Operations exceeding twelve (12) hours require prior approval from the Contracting Officer. The vessel will operate under Coast Guard tasking and prioritization while the contractor retains responsibility for safe vessel operations in accordance with applicable flag-state, class, and regulatory requirements. Depending on mission requirements and vessel capabilities, the vessel would be utilized along St. Mary�s River, Straights of Mackinac, Lake Michigan, and northern Lake Huron as well as southern Lake Huron through Lake Erie) to ensure continuous minimum domestic ice capacity. PURPOSE The United States Coast Guard (USCG) is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing appropriate vessel platforms with competent officers and crew to service the Coast Guard�s domestic ice-breaking operations in the Great Lakes. The purpose of this RFI is to obtain capability information on this urgent requirement. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. Respondents are encouraged to provide detailed information regarding vessel capabilities, crew qualifications, prior experience with ice-breaking or similar deployment timelines, and any constraints that would affect performance in an emergency environment. BACKGROUND Domestic ice-breaking cutters facilitate the safe and secure flow of maritime commerce that is vital to our economic prosperity throughout the winter. They ensure commercial shipping movements proceed through the ice without delay, free commercial vessels beset in ice, and maintain channels through the ice for ferries that serve as lifelines for isolated communities. The specific services requested include: Marine Transportation: Maintain commercial channels to ensure vessel transits and delivery of cargo. Urgent Vessel Response: Assisting transit-locked vessels before their structural integrity degrades (e.g., preventing hull breach under shifting ice pressure). Exigent Community Services: Breaking ice jams to prevent severe localized flooding or to assist isolated communities requiring emergency supplies. Search and Rescue (SAR): Assist with saving lives or responding to exigent hazards on ice-locked waters. REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested parties are invited to submit responses that include, at a minimum, the following information: 1. Company Information Company name, address, point of contact, email, and phone number UEI and CAGE code Business size status under the relevant NAICS code, such as small or large 2. Vessel Information Vessel name(s), type, flag, ownership, build (including year built and place of build), and whether the vessel is Jones Act / coastwise qualified. The Government is only interested in U.S.-flag, coastwise?qualified vessels. Principal dimensions, including length overall, beam, and draft Fuel capacity and endurance Crew accommodations and manning levels Availability to house 1 (one) Coast Guard ship-rider to facilitate comms with Tactical Commander Confirmation that the vessel can be in the Great Lakes by 02 January 2027. 3. Operational Capability Ice Breaking Specific Food/fuel endurance for seven days Break 12� or greater 1st year freshwater ice Navigational draft 18�; actual draft 13�6� 4. Notional Cost Information (Optional, for Planning Purposes Only) High-level, non-binding pricing information, such as typical daily rate ranges, mobilization and demobilization concepts, and any key cost drivers, sufficient to support Government market research. 5. Additional Information Any constraints, risks, assumptions, or innovative approaches that would inform the Government�s planning for domestic ice-breaking operations DISCLAIMER This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation, and no contract will be awarded directly from this announcement. The Government is not obligated to issue a solicitation or award any contract as a result of this RFI. The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the review of their submissions. Information submitted in response to this RFI will not be returned. Respondents are responsible for clearly marking any proprietary or business-sensitive information.

title: Verkkopalvelun laatu- ja palautetyökalu SaaS-palveluna
description: Verkkopalvelun laatu- ja palautetyökalu SaaS-palveluna Traficomin verkkopalvelut ovat keskeinen asiointi-, neuvonta- ja tiedotuskanava kansalaisille, yrityksille ja muille sidosryhmille. Verkkopalveluissa julkaistaan ajantasaista tietoa, ohjeita, päätöksiä ja palveluja. Hankinnan tavoitteena on tukea Traficomin verkkopalvelujen jatkuvaa kehittämistä, seurantaa ja laadunvarmistusta. Hankittavien palvelujen avulla Traficom voi seurata verkkopalvelujen käyttöä, käyttäjäpalautetta, saavutettavuutta ja laatua sekä kehittää verkkopalveluja tiedon perusteella. Hankinnan kohteena on Tilaajan käyttöön tuleva verkkopalvelun laatu- ja palautetyökalu ohjelmistopalveluna. Ohjelmistopalvelu koostuu kolmesta moduulista: moduuli 1 saavutettavuus, moduuli 2 kävijäpalaute ja moduuli 3 analytiikka. Moduuleja voidaan sopimuskaudella ottaa käyttöön ja poistaa käytöstä joustavasti tarpeiden mukaisesti. Sopimus on määräaikaisena voimassa viisi (5) vuotta sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Tilaajalla on oikeus jatkaa sopimusta kahdelle (2) yhden (1) vuoden pituisella optiolla. Tilaaja ilmoittaa Toimittajalle option käyttämisestä viimeistään kolme (3) kuukautta ennen varsinaisen sopimuskauden tai ensimmäisen optiokauden päättymistä. Option käyttäminen on Tilaajan yksinomaisessa harkintavallassa. Tarkempi hankinnan kohteen kuvaus, palvelun vaatimukset ja sopimusehdot on esitetty tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa dokumenteissa.,

description: Η τοπογραφία της Περιφέρειας Αττικής είναι εξαιρετικά πολύπλοκη. Κυριαρχούν οι ορεινοί όγκοι, το λεκανοπέδιο και η παράκτια ακτογραμμή, με ένα πολύπλοκο αστικό-ημιαστικό περιβάλλον με ιδιαίτερα χαρακτηριστικά, τόσο από πλευράς μετεωρολογίας όσο και από πλευράς ποιότητας του περιβάλλοντος γενικότερα. Oι κάτοικοι της Περιφέρειας Αττικής βρίσκονται συχνά εκτεθειμένοι σε αερομεταφερόμενα σωματίδια, μεταξύ των οποίων και η γύρις (ή άλλα βιο-σωματίδια) και γενικότερα σε μια υποβαθμισμένη ποιότητα φωτισμού και επίπεδα θορύβου. Αποτέλεσμα όλων αυτών είναι η καθημερινή υποβάθμιση της ποιότητας ζωής τους. H μεταβλητότητα αυτών των περιβαλλοντικών συνθηκών έχει άμεσο αντίκτυπο στην ψυχική και σωματική υγεία των κατοίκων. Η καλή υγεία των πολιτών στηρίζεται στη σωστή ενημέρωση και ο πολίτης ο οποίος γνωρίζει καλύτερα την ποιότητα του περιβάλλοντος μέσα στο οποίο δραστηριοποιείται καθώς και τους ενδεχόμενους κινδύνους στους οποίους μπορεί να εκτεθεί, είναι και εκείνος που μπορεί να έχει την καλύτερη δυνατή υγειονομική προστασία και τη μεγαλύτερη δυνατή απόδοση στην εργασία του. Στα ιδιαίτερα περιβαλλοντικά χαρακτηριστικά της Περιφέρειας περιλαμβάνονται και τα πάσης φύσεως αιωρούμενα σωματίδια με διαφορετική προέλευση αστική, περιαστική, θαλάσσια ακόμα και από διακρατική μεταφορά, όπως είναι η περίπτωση της μεταφοράς σκόνης από την έρημο Σαχάρα. Μεταξύ των αερομεταφερόμενων ρύπων συμπεριλαμβάνονται τα αλλεργιογόνα βιο-σωματίδια όπως είναι τα βακτήρια, οι ιοί και οι μύκητες, αλλά και πληθώρα ξένων προς την ατμόσφαιρα ουσιών οι οποίες μπορεί να έχουν σημαντικές επιπτώσεις στην υγεία των κατοίκων. Η δράση αποσκοπεί στη δημιουργία υποδομής υψηλής στάθμης η οποία θα προβαίνει καθημερινά σε μια 3-διάστατη τομογραφία και απεικόνιση του μείγματος των αιωρούμενων σωματιδίων, παράλληλα με μετρήσεις ακτινοβολίας, φωτορύπανσης, ηχητικής ρύπανσης και των λοιπών παραμέτρων που έχουν σχέση με την ποιότητα ζωής και την υγεία των κατοίκων της Περιφέρειας Αττικής. Η τομογραφία αυτή περιλαμβάνει την εγκατάσταση υψηλής τεχνολογίας συστημάτων για την εξ’ αποστάσεως μέτρηση αιωρουμένων σωματιδίων, βιοσωματιδίων (προερχόμενα από γύρη, ερημική σκόνη ή καύση βιομάζας από εστίες θέρμανσης-δασικές πυρκαγιές), αέριων ρύπων, υπεριώδους ηλιακής ακτινοβολίας, ηχητικής ρύπανσης αλλά και των συνθηκών νυχτερινού φωτισμού σε ολόκληρη την Περιφέρεια Αττικής. Επίσης περιλαμβάνει τη χρήση επιτόπιων μετρήσεων ρύπων και μετεωρολογικών παραμέτρων καθώς και τη χρήση ατμοσφαιρικών μοντέλων (φυσικών και χημικών) και μοντέλων διασποράς για την πρόγνωση όχι μόνο των μετεωρολογικών συνθηκών αλλά και της ποιότητας του περιβάλλοντος σε όλη την Περιφέρεια Αττικής

description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Alongside Aircraft Refueling Services to include managing, maintaining, and operating Government Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities and equipment at Cannon, AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. title: Polarization Synthesizer
description: The National Research Council Canada requires the supply of a polarization synthesizer capable of generating and controlling well-defined, rapidly varying polarization states to enable accurate characterization and testing of polarization-dependent components. A polarization synthesizer provides deterministic and programmable control of SOP, enabling reproducible laboratory emulation of real-world polarization effects. The Polarization Synthesizer should be designed to deliver high-speed, precise polarization control, making it a valuable tool for validating polarization-sensitive devices and improving the reliability and performance of optical communication and photonic technologies.

title: Steveston (Paramount) Utility Dike Crossings, Richmond, BC
description: Small Craft Harbours (SCH) requires the installation of underground High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) casings through an existing dike, at four (4) locations (Crossing A, B, C and D) in Steveston Paramount in preparation for future electrical and water underground installations. Summary of crossings are as follows: • Crossing A – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter for electrical and communication. • Crossing B – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline plus multiple tie ins to existing water pipe. • Crossing C – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter and 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for electrical, communication and waterline • Crossing D – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline. Crossing A and C require installation of electrical and communication pull box on both sides of the dike. title: Purchase of One (1) Liquid Chromatography System
description: Tendering Procedures: Invitation to tenders following instructions on the Supply Arrangement Competitive Procurement Strategy: Contract against the SA will be awarded to the supplier responding to all mandatory technical criteria and with the lowest price. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: No Nature of Requirements: Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, SA E60PV-19EQUI for the purchase of : One (1) Liquid Chromatography System Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, Kentville Research and Development Centre THIS REQUEST IS RESERVED FOR HOLDERS OF SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT # E60PV-19EQUI ONLY, FOR THE PURCHASE OF LABORATORY AND SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT, PARTS AND ACCESSORIES, SERVICES AND SUPPLIES. Only Suppliers currently pre-qualified on Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI have been invited to bid. As a requirement of the Supply Arrangement, this notice is published on Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) for a period of 40 calendar days. The closing date published on this notice identifies how long the notice will be published. For the closing date of any solicitation under the supply arrangement, invited suppliers should refer to the solicitation documents. Suppliers that do not have a Supply Arrangement for the supply of Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies with Public Works and Government Services Canada, cannot submit a bid. Any bids received from suppliers not pre-qualified on the Supply Arrangement will not be evaluated. Suppliers may qualify under Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies, at any time. Interested suppliers should download solicitation document E60PV-19EQUI/D from CanadaBuys (SAP Ariba) and submit a response as per the requirements of the Request for Supply Arrangement. The responsive bidder already holding a Supply arrangement for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies from Public Works and Government Services Canada who meets the mandatory technical criteria with the lowest aggregate price will be recommended for contract award. The mandatory technical criteria are: Liquid Chromatography (LC) System a. The LC system must be supplied with an LC solution suitable for proteomics, such as a nano-flow LC system for peptide sample preparation and separation, designed for seamless coupling to the MS. The system must operate at flow rates ranging from at least 200 nL/min to 100 µL/min and must not require a flow splitter. b. The LC system must have the maximum operating pressure at least to 15,000 psi. c. The LC system must be capable of operating within a pH range of 2–10. d. The LC system must support two-dimensional (2D) LC analysis, including an auxiliary solvent and trap valve manager, a column-trapping pump, nano-Lock spray capability, primary check valves, column compartment, and switching valves configured for 2D operation. All primary wetted materials must be included. e. The LC system must support unattended operation, with full diagnostic data display for up to 96 hours through the control software. f. The LC system must include solvent storage, with a solvent tray capable of accommodating up to three (3) eluents. g. The LC system must include a micro-binary solvent delivery system, supporting solvents A1 or A2 and B1 or B2, and must provide solvent conditioning, gradient formation, primary check valves, compressibility compensation, and automatic priming. Pump compositional precision must be < 0.25% RSD based on repeated injections. The system must be equipped with an integrated, programmable active wash system to flush the rear of the high-pressure seals. h. The LC system must include a sample handling system with an injection volume range from 0.1 µL to 100 µL, with 5 µL standard injection, supporting 1, 2, 5, 20, 50, and 100 µL injection options, and unlimited volume for trapping. The system must have full-loop and partial-loop injection modes. The autosampler must accommodate 96- or 48-position sample plates with 2.0 mL vials and include a temperature-controlled autosampler (4.0–40.0 °C) with high temperature accuracy and stability. The system must have a column chamber (temperature controlled). i. All equipment must be certified or approved for use in accordance with the Canadian Electrical Code; j. The LC system must be CSA certified upon delivery.

title: Design, Installation, Maintenance and Support of Electronic Security Systems
description: Given the evolving threat environment both in Canada and internationally, NRCan is focused on strengthening the physical security posture of its facilities. This includes improving access control, surveillance, and intrusion detection capabilities to ensure personnel safety and operational continuity. NRCan operates an electronic security and surveillance system consisting of access control, video management, and intrusion detection systems deployed across multiple locations nationwide. The system is maintained through a combination of in-house IT and security resources, as well as contracted security system support and integration services. The system transitioned from legacy analog infrastructure to an IP-based architecture between 2016 and 2020, with ongoing enhancements through 2023. The current security system is built on a hybrid cloud and on-premises architecture, designed to balance cost and performance with confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements. The system includes approximately 500 card readers and 500 cameras across more than 25 sites and is monitored through the NRCan Security Operations Control Centre (SOCC) located at 580 Booth Street in Ottawa, Ontario.
